data.name: Ulisa
data.long_meaning: Ulisa is derived from the Greek name Ulissia, which means 'ulis' (ultra) and 'issa' (goddess of light). In early Christian tradition, Ulisa was considered a name for a wealthy and enlightened woman. This name is often associated with the virtues of faith, hope, and charity.
